_meta.note: The adapter is the Real Adapter Contract lane's pinned build (test/real_adapters/package.json, npm ci): codex-acp 2.2.2, driven over stdio by a scratch client against a loopback Responses-API model stub, so no real model or credential was involved. The stub finds the target tool in the request's own tool list and asks for it with one function_call, then answers with the function_call_output it got back. After session/new the client sets mode read-only over session/set_config_option, the routing Crew arms on every codex session (Routing.SESSION_CONFIG), and answers the permission request allow_once. Agent-to-client lines verbatim and in order, with these reductions at capture: the session uuid is a fixed name and the scratch working directory reads ~/work; the available_commands_update frame (the adapter's command inventory) is dropped; models.availableModels is emptied and each multi-option select in configOptions keeps only its current value, as codex/session-live.jsonl does. The session/new array carried exactly one element: `probe`, as Kiro Crew's codex mirror projected it (providers/mirrors/codex.py codex_projection) out of a throwaway saved member spec (tools [@probe], one stdio MCP server whose one tool, probe_codeword, returns tangerine-42), with consumed_spec_matches true against a saved intent stamped the way a save stamps it. The model's call reached the spec's server: tool_call mcp.probe.probe_codeword, a session/request_permission marked is_mcp_tool_approval, and a completed tool_call_update whose rawOutput is tangerine-42.
